title: fix(console): show the producer’s localized userMessage on metadata-save advisories and refusals
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNqdmUjc8V44JGCn8TZEDmm)_

Fixes #32657

Refs #33524 (console half pinned, no console change; the card stays open for its server half)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：保存元数据后弹出的「提醒」以及保存被拒时的问题列表，现在显示服务端按用户语言写好的那句话（`userMessage`），不再显示给开发者看的英文 `message`/`hint`；Studio 被拒保存的提示句也直接用这句话，不再由控制台自己翻译服务端英文。服务端没写这句话的条目保持原样。另外给新建/编辑记录弹窗加了钉子测试：带 `userMessage` 的 403（中英文）显示该原因，不带的仍显示通用的「你没有权限保存此记录」。
- 为什么改：执行维护者裁决「32440 选C，32043 一起按C处理」的第 3 层：服务端（#33276、#33290）已按请求语言写好用户文案，控制台要直接渲染。#33524 实测：弹窗本来就先读 `userMessage`，HotCRM 看到通用句是因为 plugin-security 的「需要主记录编辑权限」拒绝根本没带 `userMessage`，那是服务端的缺口，本 PR 不改服务端。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台读哪个字段来显示；没有 `userMessage` 的条目逐字不变。`@object-ui/data-objectstack` 的 `MetadataValidationIssue` 多一个可选字段（只加不减）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts` 的 `formatFinding`；`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-error.ts` 的 `formatMetadataIssue`；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts` 的 `issueRefusal`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/providers/AdapterProvider.advisoryUserMessage-32657.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿，其中中文用例在真实 sonner 弹出的提醒里读到「权限集“sales_rep”的持有者只能看到……」，读不到英文 message。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约复审记录由席位补）。

## What changes

Layer 3 of tracking #32654 (ruling C on #32440, 「32440 选C，32043 一起按C处理」): the console renders the user-facing text the producer composed in the request's language, with no per-code key table of its own.

- **Advisory toast** (`saveAdvisoryToast.ts`, `formatFinding`, `@object-ui/app-shell`). An advisory finding that carries `userMessage` (`RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema.userMessage`, which the save and publish doors compose since #33276) renders as `[rule] where — USER_MESSAGE`, in place of the developer-facing English `message` and `hint`. The rule id and `where` are locators and frame both faces. A finding without one keeps `[rule] where — message hint`. The module header now says which prose is shown.
- **The one issue reader** (`metadata-error.ts`, `formatMetadataIssue`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`). A 422 issue with `userMessage` renders `• path — USER_MESSAGE`; one without keeps `• path — message`. `formatMetadataError` and app-shell's `formatPublishFailures` both write issues through it, so the banners, the field designer's refusal and the publish-failure list follow.
- **Studio's refusal sentence** (`metadataError.ts`, `issueRefusal`). When the issue carries `userMessage`, the sentence's problem part is that text verbatim; only an issue without one has its English `message` read through `translateValidationMessage`, the console's own table. This is the console-side translation of server prose the ruling retires where the producer speaks.
- **Type** (`metadata-client.ts`). `MetadataValidationIssue` gains optional `userMessage`, typed `RuntimeAuthoringIssue['userMessage']` from `@objectstack/spec/api`, so a rename in the spec stops it compiling. Published interface, optional member: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32657-console-localized-user-text.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` patch, with both declaration lines.

The presence test is the same predicate in all three readers (a non-empty string after trimming, the rule `@objectstack/client` applies when it lifts `userMessage`). `declaredUserMessage` (`@object-ui/react`) is the one reader of an API ERROR's marking; it was not reused here because a finding element is not an error, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` sits below `@object-ui/react` (no import that way), and `saveAdvisoryToast.ts` imports nothing that renders by design.

## Why

- **#32657** reproduced on `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4`: the toast never read `advisories[].userMessage`, `formatMetadataIssue` never read `issues[].userMessage`, and `issueRefusal` translated the English `message` console-side.
- **#33524** did not reproduce in the console. The console's New and Edit buttons open `ModalForm` (app-shell `console/AppContent.tsx`), which rethrows a refused write into the components form renderer; its refusal reader takes `declaredUserMessage(error)` before the fixed `form.noPermissionToSave` line, as do `FormPage.tsx`'s `refusalText` and the edit OCC path (`occSave.tsx`). The master-edit refusal reaches the console with no `userMessage`: plugin-security's `masterEditDenied` (`security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`) throws a bare `PermissionDeniedError` whose `message` is the developer sentence "requires edit access to its master record", and #33290 localized other refusals, not this one. So the generic line is the correct reading of what the server sends, and acceptance 1 and 2 of #33524 need the producer to compose a localized `userMessage` naming the master. That is a server change this PR does not make; the card stays open for it (seat ruling in the card thread).

## Tests

- New `AdapterProvider.advisoryUserMessage-32657.test.tsx` (rendered end to end): the real `AdapterProvider` builds the real adapter, the real SDK client parses a save response from a `fetch` double, and the real sonner `Toaster` draws the toast; the assertions read the toast's text on screen.
  - a zh-CN `userMessage` (the `security-private-no-readscope` catalog sentence for these params) shows, with the rule id, and neither the English `message` nor `hint` shows;
  - an en `userMessage` shows the same way;
  - CONTROL: a finding without one keeps `message` + `hint` + rule.
- `saveAdvisoryToast.test.ts`: two cases added (the exact line with a `userMessage`; CONTROL: a blank one is no sentence).
- New `metadataError.issueUserMessage-32657.test.ts`: `formatMetadataIssue` with and without `userMessage`; `formatMetadataError` and `formatPublishFailures` carry it; `flowSaveRefusal` (through `issueRefusal`) carries a zh `userMessage` verbatim and not the console's translation, and CONTROL: an issue without one keeps the console's reading.
- New `ModalForm.markedRefusal-33524.test.tsx` (rendered; the dialog the console's New and Edit buttons open): the user types and presses the dialog's own Create or Update button, the data source refuses with a 403 shaped as the ObjectStack adapter throws it.
  - create and edit, each with an en and a zh-CN `userMessage`: the sentence shows, the generic line does not, the developer `message` does not;
  - CONTROL, create and edit: a 403 with no `userMessage` shows the generic line and withholds the developer `message`.

<details><summary>Red-first on base, and ablations</summary>

- **Base.** The four production files checked out at `e3f0cfd4` (tree only), the new and edited tests kept: Test Files 3 failed, 1 passed (4); Tests 6 failed, 26 passed (32). The six reds are exactly the `userMessage` cases of the three #32657 files; the controls passed. `ModalForm.markedRefusal-33524.test.tsx` passed on base, 6 of 6: the #33524 console half does not reproduce. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablations** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. ui vitest reads `@object-ui/*` from source, so no build sits between mutation and run.
  - A1 `formatFinding`'s `userMessage` branch made unreachable: Tests 3 failed, 18 passed; the reds are the two rendered `userMessage` cases and the unit case; both controls green.
  - A2 `formatMetadataIssue` made to read `message` always: Tests 2 failed, 3 passed.
  - A3 `issueRefusal`'s `userMessage` branch made unreachable: Tests 1 failed, 4 passed.
  - A4 (the #33524 pin's bite) the form renderer's refusal reader made to answer the generic line for any permission error before `declaredUserMessage`: Tests 4 failed, 2 passed; the four marked cases red, the two CONTROLs green. The first A4 attempt passed a two-line anchor and was refused before running anything; it was rerun with a one-line anchor.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **#33524 is referenced, not closed.** Its console half is pinned with no console change (above). Its producer half, plugin-security's master-edit refusal composing a localized `userMessage` that names the master, is reported to the seat as a server finding; the seat re-lanes the card.
- **#32440's post-save advisory half** is met by this PR: the advisory toast now renders the producer's localized sentence wherever the save door sends one. Rules the producer has written no sentence for still show their English `message` and `hint`, as the contract declares (the remaining catalogue is tracked on #32835).
- **#32043's member-limit sentence** is not met by this PR: that refusal (`DEVELOPER_ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED`) is produced by cloud. If cloud sends it with a `userMessage`, the invite dialog's reader decides what shows; this PR did not measure that dialog.
- **Other write-error readers.** Several console surfaces read a write error through `extractWriteErrorMessage` alone (for example the sharing-rule clone dialog and the position and assigned-user sections), which reads the server's `error` / `message` and not `userMessage`. Noted, not changed here: outside this card's declared surface.
- **File surface:** as declared to the seat (the four production files above, their tests, one new plugin-form test, the changeset). No i18n key, no `FormPage.tsx` or `flowResponse.ts` edit, no server, spec or cloud change.

## Verification

Run on head `e0302529` (base `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4`).

<details><summary>Build, tests, type-check and lint</summary>

- Builds under the verify lock: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/spec...' --filter '@objectstack/formula...' --filter '@objectstack/client...' --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/sdui-parser...' build` (VERDICT command-exit 0), then `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- The four new or edited test files: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 32 passed (32).
- Neighbouring suites, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/data-objectstack/ packages/app-shell/src/providers/ packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.refusalIssues-11302.test.tsx packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm packages/components/src/__tests__/form-write-error-message.test.tsx`: Test Files 499 passed (499), Tests 4343 passed (4343).
- Type-check, each VERDICT command-exit 0: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit`), `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test files are compiled).
- eslint on the eight changed files: 0 errors (8 warnings, all pre-existing `no-explicit-any` lines in `metadata-client.ts`). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (37)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 37 families on `e0302529`. All 37 exited 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was SIGKILLed in the loop while a 23-minute suite run held the box; rerun alone under the lock with `--maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 171 passed, 2 skipped (173), exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 37 derived, 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Changed lines: 446, under the 3,000 threshold. No dogfood battery: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
